sentences.en: Giraffes have pretty strong body odor that deters mosquitos.
sentences.zh: 长颈鹿有很强烈的体味，可以吓住蚊子。

sentences.en: The video cameras are mainly there to deter thieves.
sentences.zh: 摄像头主要用来吓阻小偷。

sentences.en: They put up a sign to deter trespassers.
sentences.zh: 他们立了一个牌子来吓阻闯入者。

senses.zh: 阻止，制止；使不敢；使踌躇
